notes.title: [UPDATE] RETSNOM ver. 1.93 RELEASED.
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone.

RETSNOM version 1.93 has been released.
The update will be applied automatically when you restart RETSNOM. 
The major changes include:

[list]
[*] Improved horizontal movement while you fly in the world 3, 4, and 5
[*] Fixed compatibility with macOS 10.15 Catalina
[*] Fixed minor bugs
[/list]


And now you can find the new library hero image of RETSNOM in the Steam client. :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9300019/4278035fbe3de460539ac52bf04f1e40ee083676.png[/img]

notes.title: RETSNOM Update Released (Ver. 1.53)
notes.notes:
OMG!
I didn't notice that there's a huge bug in World2!
All disappeared bricks have to be appear when players un-flip the flipped areas. But recent updates in mechanics made it wrong and I guess many players couldn't make it in World2.
I'm really sorry about that. 

Fixed version (1.53) is uploaded. If you have any other issues, please tell me. I'll do whatever it takes to make it a better game.

Thanks.

[list]
    [*]Bugs fixed : Disappeared bricks can be re-appeared in World2. (Thanks to Epicwindow :3)
[/list]

notes.title: RETSNOM Update Released (Ver. 1.3)
notes.notes:
As a South Korean indie developer, English is not a language I am all that comfortable with. And RETSNOM is not a simple puzzle game with an easy story to tell. Because of those reasons, some of the subtleties were lost in translation and the English could be quite odd at times.

Here's the article at GAMASUTRA about my game and communication without words.
[url=www.gamasutra.com/view/news/253440/Communicating_complex_mechanics_without_words_in_RETSNOM.php]Communicating complex mechanics without words in RETSNOM[/url]

[b]Finally, in the Ver. 1.3, English localization is much enhanced[b] with help of Sang Kwon and Albert Liu. I hope you can understand whole multiple gameplay mechanics and a storyline.

Thanks to all.

notes.title: RETSNOM Update Released (Ver. 1.2)
notes.notes:
Hello.

I'm Somi. I really appreciate your input on my game. Especially many player's opinion about 'Level skipping' and 'Repetitive stages' gave me a lot of thought to the matter. And finally, I've decided to reform the game system.

Version 1.2 Update is released.

[img=https://somicreatesgames.files.wordpress.com/2015/08/world4.png][/img]

All stages in each worlds are open after you clear the first stage except for the the last stage.
The last stages can be opened when more than 9 stages are cleared(more than 6 stages in the world 5).
It means that you can skip some stages which are much too difficult or not fun.

I hope you like the updated version. And if you have any opinion or question about RETSNOM, don't hesitate to ask to me.

Thank you so much.

Somi

notes.title: RETSNOM Update Released (Ver. 1.12)
notes.notes:
Hello, my lovely fans. 
I really thank you for buying and playing the game. I hope you like it. 
As an one-man indie developer, it's really difficult for me to get interest of press about my game. Since the release date, I've been going through tough days to promote it, but there's no one who cares about my game only except you. 
But I know that it's just the beginning and I can make it better in the end. 
Please wish me luck. I'll do my utmost. 
Thank you very much.
Sincerely,
Somi

Bug fixes: 
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug related to the Music Volume control.
[*]Fixed the door in the third hidden stage.
[*]Changed a few texts on the background images(names of worlds & the functions of mirrors).
[/list]

P.S. If you have any ideas or recommendations about RETSNOM, don't hesitate to tell me. You can change the game as you wish.

[url=store.steampowered.com/app/382920][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/382920/extras/SteamMain.png?t=1437677043[/img][/url]
